> Estimate the false discovery proportion among a search's discoveries from its entrapment hits, as a lower bound, a combined upper bound and a paired upper bound, at each of several q-value thresholds.

Wire verb `stats entrapment-fdp` · Python [`pymzlib.stats.entrapment_fdp`][pymzlib.stats.entrapment_fdp]

### Wraps

- [`EntrapmentFdp.Sweep`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/StatisticalModels/EntrapmentFdp.cs) in `mzLib/StatisticalModels/EntrapmentFdp.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`EntrapmentFdp.DefaultQValueThresholds`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/StatisticalModels/EntrapmentFdp.cs) in `mzLib/StatisticalModels/EntrapmentFdp.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`ScoredIdentification`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/StatisticalModels/EntrapmentFdp.cs) in `mzLib/StatisticalModels/EntrapmentFdp.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`ScoredEntrapment`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/StatisticalModels/EntrapmentFdp.cs) in `mzLib/StatisticalModels/EntrapmentFdp.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `targets` | `path` | required | — | — | A TSV with a header row naming EXACTLY the columns score and q_value, in any order, then one row per original-target candidate (mzLib's ScoredIdentification): the unit you estimate the FDP of (precursor, peptide or protein group), decoys removed, each with its best q-value. score is the search's score, higher is better, on the same scale as the entrapments'; q_value is the q-value the search reported, a fraction. Every cell must be a finite number. Any other column is refused: select the two before writing the file. |
| `entrapments` | `path` | required | — | — | A TSV with a header row naming the columns score, q_value, partner_score and partner_q_value, and optionally foreign, in any order, then one row per entrapment candidate (mzLib's ScoredEntrapment). partner_score and partner_q_value are a COPY of the score and q-value of the one original target this entrapment was made from, when the search identified it; leave both blank (or NA) when it did not, when it cannot be resolved to one target, or when there is none. mzLib does not check them against the targets file. foreign is 1 or true for an entrapment with no target partner by construction (a foreign species), 0 or false otherwise; a blank cell, or no foreign column, is mzLib's default (ScoredEntrapment.IsForeign false). Any other column is refused, so a misspelt foreign column cannot fall back to the default. |
| `ratio` | `float` | required | entrapment-to-target database size ratio (unitless) | `> 0 and finite (mzLib's rule; anything else is mzLib's refusal, a usage error)` | r, the effective ratio of entrapment to target database size, used by the combined estimate. REQUIRED: mzLib has no default. paired is reported only when r is exactly 1: for 1:1 pairing give 1 itself, not a ratio computed from database sizes after exclusions (0.9998 drops it). |
| `thresholds` | `float[]` | absent | q-value (fraction, 0 to 1) | `comma-separated finite numbers` | The q-value thresholds to estimate at, comma-separated, in the order the rows should come in. A candidate is discovered at a threshold when its q-value is at or below it. Absent, the bridge sends mzLib's EntrapmentFdp.DefaultQValueThresholds (0.001, 0.002, ..., 0.100, each i/1000, at d10017ce) and echoes them. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `targets_file` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the targets table. |
| `entrapments_file` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the entrapments table. |
| `ratio` | `float` | entrapment-to-target database size ratio (unitless) | never | r, as given. |
| `thresholds` | `float[]` | q-value (fraction, 0 to 1) | never | The thresholds estimated at, in order: the --thresholds given, or mzLib's default. |
| `thresholds_given` | `bool` | — | never | True when --thresholds was given; false when thresholds is mzLib's DefaultQValueThresholds. |
| `target_candidate_count` | `int` | candidates | never | Rows read from the targets file. |
| `entrapment_candidate_count` | `int` | candidates | never | Rows read from the entrapments file. |
| `foreign_count` | `int` | candidates | never | Entrapments marked foreign. |
| `partnered_count` | `int` | candidates | never | Entrapments with a partner. |
| `threshold_count` | `int` | thresholds | never | The length of thresholds. |
| `empty_threshold_count` | `int` | thresholds | never | Thresholds at which nothing was discovered, where every estimate is 0/0, so mzLib leaves them out of the table. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | threshold_count - empty_threshold_count. |
| `column_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The table's columns, in order. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | One row per threshold with a discovery, in thresholds order. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Five static caveats, plus one each when a threshold had no discoveries, when paired is null at every threshold (with the ratio and the foreign count), and when no entrapment has a partner. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q_value_threshold` | `float` | q-value (fraction, 0 to 1) | never | The threshold. |
| `target_count` | `int` | discoveries | never | N_T: targets with a q-value at or below the threshold. |
| `entrapment_count` | `int` | discoveries | never | N_E: entrapments with a q-value at or below the threshold. |
| `lower_bound` | `float` | fraction of discoveries (an FDP estimate) | never | Eq. 2, N_E / (N_T + N_E). A lower bound on the FDP: above the claimed FDR, it shows the search fails to control it; below, it shows nothing. |
| `combined` | `float` | fraction of discoveries (an FDP estimate; can exceed 1) | never | Eq. 1, N_E (1 + 1/r) / (N_T + N_E). An upper bound: at or below the claimed FDR, it is evidence of control. Not capped at 1. |
| `paired` | `float` | fraction of discoveries (an FDP estimate; can exceed 1) | yes: does not apply: the ratio is not exactly 1, or every entrapment is foreign | Eq. 4, (N_E + N_{E>=s>T} + 2 N_{E>T>=s}) / (N_T + N_E): a tighter upper bound for 1:1 pairing. N_{E>=s>T} counts discovered entrapments whose partner was not discovered (no partner counts so); N_{E>T>=s} those whose partner was discovered but ranked behind them, by lower q-value and then higher score, an exact tie counting the entrapment ahead. Not capped at 1. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | targets or entrapments missing, blank or not found; a table empty; a header with an empty, repeated, missing or unknown column (each named); a row whose field count differs from its header; a score or q_value that is not a finite number; a partner with a score but no q-value or the reverse, or not finite; a foreign cell other than 0, 1, true, false or blank |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | --ratio absent, without a value or not a number; --thresholds without a value, empty, or with an entry that is not a finite number |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | mzLib refuses the ratio (its ArgumentOutOfRangeException, reclassified): not a positive finite number |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | never expected |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- Wen et al. 2025, as FDRBench implements it. lower_bound can only show that a search fails to control its FDR; combined is an upper bound, evidence that it does; paired is a tighter upper bound for 1:1 pairing. None is capped at 1.
- A candidate is discovered when its q-value is at or below the threshold, and a partner by its own q-value. A discovered pair is ranked lower q-value first, then higher score, and an exact tie counts against the search.
- Give one row per unit estimated (precursor, peptide or protein group), decoys removed, each with its best q-value: mzLib does not deduplicate. A partner's score and q-value are copies of its target's row, and mzLib does not check them.
- paired is reported only for a ratio of exactly 1 with some entrapment not foreign. The sample estimator N_E / (r N_T), invalid in both directions, is deliberately absent (mzLib), and the k-fold paired estimator for k entrapments per target is not implemented.
- An entrapment generator's exclusions change the inputs in opposite directions (mzLib's EntrapmentFdp.ClassifyExclusion): an entrapment that is really a target peptide comes out of the entrapments file; a target that cannot be traced to one target stays in the targets file but is nobody's partner.

### Example

```python
fdp = pymzlib.stats.entrapment_fdp('entrapment_reference_targets.tsv', 'entrapment_reference_entrapments.tsv', ratio=1.0)
```

```python
fdp = pymzlib.stats.entrapment_fdp('entrapment_reference_targets.tsv', 'entrapment_reference_entrapments.tsv', ratio=2.0, thresholds=[0.01, 0.05])
```
